form.label: CVE response
form.description: The latest new CVEs are at the top (click one to fill in the CVE). Enter a CVE (saved or with a Rapid7 check). For a CVE that is not saved, also give the software and vulnerable versions. Lists affected servers with version, scan freshness against the announcement, Rapid7 result and verdict; preview and launch a rescan. INACTIVE and DECOMMISSION servers are hidden and never rescanned.

search.query: | r7cve cve=$cve|s$ software=$software|s$ ranges=$ranges|s$ announced=$announced|s$ env=$env|s$ app=$app|s$

input.label: Software (if not saved), e.g. PHP or Apache*HTTP*

panel.title: Latest 10 new CVEs in Rapid7 (newest first, refreshes every hour; click a CVE to fill in the CVE ID)

search.query: | inputlookup r7_recent_checks.csv | where rollup=0 AND fresh_cve=1 | eval a=substr(added,1,10), p=substr(published,1,10), cve=split(cves_str,"|") | mvexpand cve | stats min(a) as added min(p) as published first(title) as title first(component) as software first(platform) as platform first(severity) as severity max(cvss_v3) as cvss_v3 by cve | join type=left cve [| inputlookup r7_recent_hits.csv | search cmdb_status="WORKING_ACTIVE" | stats dc(eval(if(env_label="Prod · DC",asset_id,null()))) as prod_dc dc(eval(if(env_label="Prod · DR",asset_id,null()))) as prod_dr dc(eval(if(env_group="Non-prod",asset_id,null()))) as non_prod dc(eval(if(env_label="INFRA",asset_id,null()))) as infra values(os) as os_list by cve] | fillnull value=0 prod_dc prod_dr non_prod infra | eval os_list=mvjoin(os_list,"; ") | where like(lower(cve), lower("%$l_cve$%")) AND like(lower(coalesce(software,"")), lower("%$l_sw$%")) AND like(lower(coalesce(platform,"")), lower("%$l_plat$%")) AND like(lower(coalesce(os_list,"")), lower("%$l_os$%")) AND coalesce(tonumber(cvss_v3),0)>=$l_cvss$ AND ("$l_pub$"="" OR published>="$l_pub$") AND ("$l_add$"="" OR added>="$l_add$") | eval new=if(added>=strftime(relative_time(now(),"-1d@d"),"%Y-%m-%d"),"NEW","") | sort - added - cvss_v3 | head 10 | table new added cve title software platform os_list severity cvss_v3 published prod_dc prod_dr non_prod infra | rename platform as "vendor / platform" os_list as "your servers' OS" prod_dc as "Prod · DC" prod_dr as "Prod · DR" non_prod as "Non-prod" infra as "INFRA"

html.p: Enter a CVE ID (or click one in the latest CVEs above), or the software and vulnerable versions, then Submit. The panels below appear once a CVE or software is given.

search.query: | head 1 | eval vuln_ids=mvjoin(vuln_ids,", ") | table cve rapid7_check check_added severity cvss_v3 announced software ranges vuln_ids
| stats count as servers count(eval(env_group="Prod")) as prod count(eval(env_group="Non-prod")) as non_prod by verdict | sort verdict

| stats count as servers by freshness | eval meaning=case(freshness="Fresh","scanned after announcement", freshness="OK","scanned shortly before", freshness="Stale","too old: rescan", freshness="None","no software data: fix credentials")

panel.title: 2 · Servers: version, scan freshness, Rapid7 result, verdict

search.query: | where (like(lower(hostname), lower("%$s_host$%")) OR like(ip, "%$s_host$%")) AND like(lower(coalesce(os,"")), lower("%$s_os$%")) | search verdict="$s_verdict$" | eval appname=mvjoin(appname,", ") | table hostname ip env_label appname os product version range_status last_scan freshness days_before_announced r7_result verdict action site_name | sort verdict env_label hostname

input.label: Which servers
input.choice: All that need a rescan (not yet confirmed "Not affected")

search.query: | where verdict!="Not affected" | eval label=hostname." · ".env_label." · ".verdict | table asset_id label

button.data-r7-confirm: Launch the Rapid7 rescan now? Prod servers are scanned immediately.

p.span: Needs the rapid7_cve_rescan role. Max 50 servers per job. Requests are recorded now; the scans start once the 1.2.0 executor on the forwarder is installed. Follow them on Scan jobs & reports.

search.query: | r7rescan cve=$cve|s$ software=$software|s$ ranges=$ranges|s$ announced=$announced|s$ env=$env|s$ app=$app|s$ hosts=$hosts|s$ only_hosts=$only$ scope=affected dryrun=true detail=true

| r7rescan cve=$cve|s$ software=$software|s$ ranges=$ranges|s$ announced=$announced|s$ env=$env|s$ app=$app|s$ hosts=$hosts|s$ only_hosts=$only$ scope=affected dryrun=false request_id=$launch_nonce|s$ launched_from="CVE response"
